verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Perplexity call the Vanta API to query controls and remediate failing tests, with region-specific hosted endpoints and a remediation quickstart. It also offers a separate Developer Docs MCP server, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
